description: Hyundai Ioniq Electric — tire pressure and temperature detail: per-wheel temperature-normalised cold-equivalent pressure in bar, per-wheel temperature excess, inter-wheel pressure spread, and trend history. The pressure panels and the shipped alerts read the bar series (derived/tire_*_bar_cold, derived/tire_spread_bar) from issue #1478 onward. The parallel psi series is still written but no panel reads it, so pressure history from before that cutover is not visible here — it is still queryable as derived/tire_*_psi_cold, at 14.5038 psi per bar.

panels.description: This morning's cold-start pressure for the front-left tire (derived/tire_fl_bar_coldstart) — the wheel's RAW pressure from the first fresh TPMS frame after a park of 6 h or more, published at most once per local calendar day. This IS the value the shipped under-inflation alerts evaluate (low <2.20, critical <1.90 bar); the tire has equilibrated with ambient overnight, so it is directly comparable to the 2.5 bar cold placard with no compensation. ONE POINT PER DRIVING DAY: it stays frozen between mornings, and a 30-day lookback carries the last reading across a week of not driving — a frozen value is expected, not stale. Nothing is published on a day the car is not driven, or for a second long park later the same day (a tire that has sat in the sun is not a cold one). The >2.90 red band is a sanity guide only: the over-inflation alert evaluates the normalised series in the trend panel below, not this one.

targets.query: SELECT last("value") AS "fl_bar_coldstart" FROM "ioniq" WHERE "group"='derived/tire_fl_bar_coldstart' AND time > now() - 30d

panels.description: How much hotter the front-left tire runs than the mean of the other three wheels (derived/tire_fl_temp_excess). Healthy near 0 °C; the "tire hot" alert fires above 8 °C sustained for 10 min (a dragging brake, a failing bearing, or under-inflation). The bot suppresses this signal unless all four wheels refreshed within one window and the car rolled recently, so gaps are expected. Driving-gated like the pressure tiles — last known value shown via a 30-day lookback while parked.

panels.description: The signal the under-inflation alerts evaluate: each wheel's raw cold-start pressure (derived/tire_*_bar_coldstart), one point per wheel per driving morning, taken from the first fresh TPMS frame after a park of 6 h or more. Dashed reference lines are the alert thresholds (1.90 critical / 2.20 low bar) against the 2.5 bar cold placard. Points, not lines, because the series is genuinely one sample a day — a gap means the car was not driven that day, or its first drive was a second start after an already-warm park. PINNED TO 30 DAYS regardless of the dashboard time picker (timeFrom), because at the dashboard's 6 h default this panel would always be empty. A step down across consecutive mornings on one wheel is a leak; all four falling together at about 0.09 bar/month is ordinary permeation.

targets.query: SELECT "value" AS "fl" FROM "ioniq" WHERE "group"='derived/tire_fl_bar_coldstart' AND $timeFilter
SELECT "value" AS "fr" FROM "ioniq" WHERE "group"='derived/tire_fr_bar_coldstart' AND $timeFilter
SELECT "value" AS "rl" FROM "ioniq" WHERE "group"='derived/tire_rl_bar_coldstart' AND $timeFilter
SELECT "value" AS "rr" FROM "ioniq" WHERE "group"='derived/tire_rr_bar_coldstart' AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Cold-Start Pressure (4 wheels) — the alerting signal

panels.description: Temperature-normalised cold-equivalent pressure trend for all four wheels (derived/tire_*_bar_cold), compensated to a 15 C reference by the gas law. Driving-gated: values change only when the car is driven, and fill(previous) carries the last reading across parked gaps, so long flat segments are normal. THIS IS NOT THE UNDER-INFLATION SIGNAL: the placard is defined at ambient, not at 15 C, so a normalised value sits about 0.12 bar low at a 25 C August ambient and about 0.19 bar high at 0 C in January — the low/critical alerts moved to the cold-start panel above (issue #1479). Only the over-inflation rule (>2.90 bar, the dashed line) still reads this series; use it for trend shape and for comparing wheels against each other, where the reference temperature cancels. However, fill(previous) only carries a value forward from within the queried window: if the window opens before the most recent sample (a fully-parked 6 h stretch with no new reading), this panel can render completely EMPTY rather than flat — that is expected, not a broken feed.

targets.query: SELECT last("value") AS "fl" FROM "ioniq" WHERE "group"='derived/tire_fl_bar_cold' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)
SELECT last("value") AS "fr" FROM "ioniq" WHERE "group"='derived/tire_fr_bar_cold' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)
SELECT last("value") AS "rl" FROM "ioniq" WHERE "group"='derived/tire_rl_bar_cold' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)
SELECT last("value") AS "rr" FROM "ioniq" WHERE "group"='derived/tire_rr_bar_cold' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)

panels.title: Cold Pressure Trend (4 wheels)

panels.description: Per-wheel temperature-excess trend (derived/tire_*_temp_excess) — each wheel against the mean of the other three. Healthy near 0 °C; the dashed line at 8 °C is the "tire hot" alert threshold. One wheel diverging upward points at that corner (brake drag or low pressure). Driving-gated + fill(previous): fill(previous) only carries a value forward from within the queried window, so a fully-parked 6 h window can render this panel completely EMPTY rather than flat — that is expected, not a broken feed; the per-wheel temp-excess stat tiles above show the last known value via a 30-day lookback.

targets.query: SELECT last("value") AS "fl" FROM "ioniq" WHERE "group"='derived/tire_fl_temp_excess' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)
SELECT last("value") AS "fr" FROM "ioniq" WHERE "group"='derived/tire_fr_temp_excess' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)
SELECT last("value") AS "rl" FROM "ioniq" WHERE "group"='derived/tire_rl_temp_excess' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)
SELECT last("value") AS "rr" FROM "ioniq" WHERE "group"='derived/tire_rr_temp_excess' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)

panels.title: Temp-Excess Trend (4 wheels)

panels.description: Largest cold-pressure difference between any two wheels (derived/tire_spread_bar). Lower is better — the observed healthy baseline is ~0.08 bar. The orange band at 0.21 bar IS the ioniq-tpms-spread-high alert threshold; the red band at 0.34 bar is a sanity guide only. Driving-gated + fill(previous): fill(previous) only carries a value forward from within the queried window, so a fully-parked 6 h window can render this panel completely EMPTY rather than flat — that is expected, not a broken feed.

targets.query: SELECT last("value") AS "tire_spread_bar" FROM "ioniq" WHERE "group"='derived/tire_spread_bar' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)

panels.title: Inter-Wheel Spread

panels.description: Age of the most recent derived tire sample (timestamp of last(tire_fl_bar_cold)). Because tire signals are driving-gated, an age of hours or days while parked is NORMAL and does NOT mean the feed is broken. Reduces the Time field with unit dateTimeFromNow and a fixed 30-day lookback (never count(), which cannot distinguish fresh from days-stale, and never $timeFilter, which would read "No data" the moment the window is empty).

targets.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "ioniq" WHERE "group"='derived/tire_fl_bar_cold' AND time > now() - 30d
